newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Telstra meeting market share target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Telstra meeting market share target.

text.p: Telecoms carrier Telstra Corp, which the Australian government wants to partially privatise, said on Thursday it was meeting forecasts for market share.

"Our three-year rolling corporate plan that we turn out every year ... has pretty much been on track each year, so I guess I'd say it's met our expectations," chief executive Frank Blount told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
Blount said the carrier was winning back some customers previously lost to competitor Optus Communications Pty Ltd, but he did not provide figures.
"We lose some and we win some, but the deal is to try to net churn in as opposed to net churn out," he said.

In September Telstra reported a record net profit of A$2.3 billion for the year to June 30, up 31.5 percent on a year earlier. The Australian government plans to sell one-third of Telstra to raise about A$8.0 billion, but is currently facing a tough task in seeking parliamentary approval for the proposal.
